namespaceDescription: Compiler-grounded Kotlin source intelligence from Kast.

relativeDirectoryPath.description: Directory relative to the session workspace root, such as services/orders. Use '.' for the root. Not a file path, absolute path, glob, or package name. Parent traversal and non-canonical paths are rejected by server admission.

includeSubdirectories.description: true includes the named directory and nested directories; false selects only the named directory.

items.description: Exact imported Gradle source-set name, such as main, integrationTest, or commonMain.

sourceSetNames.description: Omission or null selects the names main and test. Otherwise use exact imported Gradle source-set names, not paths, globs, or production/test categories. Empty and duplicate lists are rejected by server admission.

packageName.description: Semantic Kotlin package name, such as com.example.orders. Not a filesystem path. Uses Kast's supported package-name grammar.

includeSubpackages.description: true includes the named package and subpackages; false selects only the named package.

items.description: Exact imported Gradle source-set name, such as main, integrationTest, or commonMain.

sourceSetNames.description: Omission or null selects the names main and test. Otherwise use exact imported Gradle source-set names, not paths, globs, or production/test categories. Empty and duplicate lists are rejected by server admission.

declarationName.description: Simple declaration name. Not a signature, source-text query, or qualified name.

nameMatch.description: Omission or null means exact, case-sensitive declaration-name matching. Exact matching returns every matching overload; it does not select one overload. Fuzzy matching requires explicit opt-in.

declarationKinds.description: null includes all families. Use a non-empty, unique subset. CLASS includes interfaces, classes, objects, enums, and annotation classes. INTERFACE is invalid. Constructors and enum entries are excluded.

scope.description: Omission or null searches the session workspace recursively in source sets main and test. Otherwise choose one directory scope or one package scope. Source-set restrictions intersect with the chosen scope.

SearchSource.description: Find declarations and establish exact symbol identities. Exact-name discovery uses name indexes and a supplemental declaration scan in the admitted scope to prove completeness. Apply known directory, package, source-set and declaration-kind constraints before discovery. Source scope restricts discovery only, not later expansion destinations.

declarationKinds.description: null includes all four supported declaration families. Supply a non-empty, non-duplicate list to restrict them. The class family means Kast's supported class-like declarations. Constructors are not included.

scope.description: Omission or null searches the session workspace recursively in source sets main and test. Otherwise choose one directory scope or one package scope. Source-set restrictions intersect with the chosen scope.

AllSource.description: Enumerate the four supported Kotlin declaration families in admitted source files, ordered by canonical file identity and source position (KOTLIN_FILE_SOURCE_V2). Bounded pages preserve undiscovered files and source positions. Resume the exact continuation to advance the same semantic universe; discovery observations report exhaustion, retained progress, or a precise terminal cause.

items.description: Copy the issued exact-symbol reference unchanged.

Output.description: Omission or null returns symbols with name and location. Choose occurrences, traversal_records, or binding_rows for their typed established evidence.

ReadResultOutput.description: Present retained symbols, compiler-confirmed occurrences, depth-bearing traversal records or typed binding rows without rerunning stages. Omission or null selects symbol fields and rejects a retained occurrence or binding-row result.

fields.description: [] requests mandatory identity and kind only. Source adds a committed bounded source window.

TraversalRecordsOutput.description: Present each compiler-confirmed walk record with its hop depth and relation fact.

Predicate.description: A closed predicate over compiler-grounded symbol facts.

values.description: Keep symbols with one of these compiler-established visibilities. Duplicate values are rejected by server admission.

field.description: Compiler-grounded name, declaration kind, or stable file identity.

value.description: Nonblank literal compared with the selected compiler-grounded field.

Where.description: Keep symbols satisfying one structured compiler-grounded predicate.

relation.description: One semantic hop. callers means declarations calling the current symbols; callees means declarations called by them. Choose output type occurrences to return individual relation facts, including repeated use sites.

expansionScope.description: Native relation expansion domain, independent of seed discovery and output filtering. Omission or null selects WORKSPACE. SOURCE_DOMAIN restricts destinations before native enumeration.

WalkDepth.description: Explicit maximum semantic hop depth, subject to the hosted bounded-depth ceiling. Omission or null requests exhaustive traversal.

WalkStrategy.description: Omission or null uses breadth-first exploration. Bounded fan-out keeps representative deeper paths and qualifies truncated coverage.

expansionScope.description: Native relation expansion domain. Omission or null selects WORKSPACE for exhaustive traversal and RETAINED_SEED for an explicit depth bound. Explicit SOURCE_DOMAIN applies before native enumeration.

Walk.description: Traverse the reachable compiler-confirmed relation graph to exhaustion by default. Omitted or null maximumDepth with omitted or null expansionScope traverses the workspace, even when seed discovery was narrow. Explicit maximumDepth selects a bounded question. Apply destination scope before enumeration; later output filters do not reduce native search work. Resource grants do not shorten the requested question; incomplete proof rejects the fixed COMPLETE_ONLY verdict.

DistinctSymbols.description: Keep the first row and its evidence for each canonical symbol identity at this position.

ProjectBinding.description: Select one named symbol cell from each retained or newly joined binding row before symbol stages continue.

ExecutionBudget.description: RUNNER_CONTROLLED has no implicit semantic work or time limit. It accepts an explicit timeout and output page controls. Legacy BOUNDED mode uses configured grants and ceilings.

maxElapsedMs.description: Explicit timeout in milliseconds for RUNNER_CONTROLLED execution, including model capture. Omission adds no timeout. Legacy BOUNDED mode uses KAST_READ_SEMANTIC_MILLIS and host clamps.

maxWorkUnits.description: Accounted work allowance. Query omission uses KAST_READ_SEMANTIC_WORK. Time and response size do not change this allowance.

maxResults.description: In BOUNDED mode, this caps results. In RUNNER_CONTROLLED mode, this caps each output page.

maxReturnedBytes.description: Query minimum: {PUBLIC_QUERY_OUTPUT_MINIMUM_BYTES} UTF-8 bytes. Omission uses KAST_READ_SEMANTIC_RETURNED_BYTES.

input.description: Append exact-symbol references or selected rows from one retained result, preserving stream order and multiplicity.

Concat.description: Concatenate a typed input at this pipeline position. Later steps transform both streams.

Intersect.description: Keep left rows whose canonical semantic identity occurs in the retained right result.

Union.description: Form a set union by canonical semantic identity while retaining source qualification.

Difference.description: Exclude right-hand canonical identities only when retained right coverage establishes absence.

ResultReference.description: Opaque retained-result reference returned by Kast. It is separate from an exact-symbol reference and an execution continuation.

ResultRowReference.description: Issued identity of one row in one retained result. Supply it with its owning result reference; restoration checks ownership.

ResultCursor.description: Optional presentation offset in the immutable retained result. Omission or null starts at zero; this cursor does not resume semantic execution.

EvidenceCursor.description: Presentation offset in retained evidence, including deferred summaries. DEFERRED_DETAIL does not mean detail delivery. READ_RESULT.detail reads selected fragments without semantic replay.

rowIds.description: Omission or null selects all rows. [] selects no rows. Otherwise select these issued rows, in order, from this result; a subset keeps its source qualification and cannot prove coverage of omitted rows.

ResultSource.description: Seed a new pipeline from a retained immutable result or selected issued rows. The same semantic basis is checked when Kast restores it, including empty selections and incomplete-coverage qualification.

source.description: Starting exact or explicit fuzzy declaration search, indexed whole-word text projected to exact containing declarations, containing named declaration at a file offset, exact-symbol references, or one retained result.

steps.description: Ordered transformations executed left to right. null and [] mean no transformations. A join reads its right side from a retained symbol result. Inner join yields binding rows with named left and right cells; project_binding selects one named cell before symbol stages continue. Semi and anti joins retain symbol rows; anti requires complete right coverage.

retention.description: Omission or null discards the completed result after returning it. retain publishes an immutable bounded same-basis result reference; publication failure is reported without erasing the query result.

RunAction.description: Run a source through zero or more nonterminal steps and exactly one terminalStep object. EMIT accepts every output projection; TRACE accepts only symbols and owns expansionScope. Keep retention and execution controls on RUN. EMIT permits 1000 steps; TRACE permits 999 before its canonical suffix.

ResumeAction.description: Read the remaining output of a completed query through its issued output continuation.

ReadResultAction.description: Present an immutable retained result, starting at the supplied result cursor; this performs no query evaluation.

ExecutionContinuation.description: Issued continuation for remaining output of a completed query. Pipeline execution continuations are internal.

BindingName.description: One bounded name for a cell in a binding row. Inner joins name their left and right cells; project_binding selects a cell by its name.

InnerJoinMode.description: Emit one typed binding row per matching pair. The two output column names must differ.

SemiJoinMode.description: Keep left symbol rows with a matching right identity, preserving left multiplicity and evidence.

AntiJoinMode.description: Keep left symbol rows only when complete right coverage proves no matching identity.

right.description: Immutable retained symbol rows. A retained binding-row result is not a symbol right input.

Join.description: Join on canonical symbol identity. Inner emits typed paired rows; semi keeps proven matches; anti requires complete right coverage to establish absence.

BindingRowsOutput.description: Present both named symbol or exact-occurrence bindings in each inner-join pair, preserving multiplicity and evidence.

file.description: Canonical workspace-relative file path containing the offset.

offset.description: UTF-16 offset inside the named declaration.

LocationSource.description: Find the nearest named declaration containing this offset, then return its exact compiler-grounded symbol.

word.description: One ASCII identifier word, matched case-sensitively as a whole word by the index. No phrases, qualified literals, substrings, alternation, or regex.

declarationKinds.description: null includes all four supported declaration families. Supply a non-empty, non-duplicate list to restrict them. The class family means Kast's supported class-like declarations. Constructors are not included.

scope.description: Omission or null searches the session workspace recursively in source sets main and test. Otherwise choose one directory scope or one package scope. Source-set restrictions intersect with the chosen scope.

TextSource.description: Find exact supported declarations containing indexed whole-word matches. Match evidence explains lexical relevance; returned refs retain exact compiler identity. File-level or unsupported hits produce an explicit projection limitation. Scope restricts discovery, not later relation destinations. A stopped indexed scan is terminal and has no continuation.

seeds.description: Exact enclosing and expected callable references plus the UTF-16 range of the whole invocation expression. Native compiler admission must confirm the invocation; an anchor or matching name is insufficient.

declarations.description: Opaque exact declaration references paired with supplied model identity claims. Native revalidation on the current basis is required before model binding; include every callable used by a representation rule.

models.description: Explicit versioned reviewed model vocabulary and rules. Model provenance remains distinct from compiler-grounded transfers.

domain.description: Semantic source expansion domain, independent of exact producer selection and output presentation.

flow.description: Versioned supported forward Kotlin value transfers. Unsupported flow retains explicit unresolved obligations.

requestedSites.description: Optional exact requested-site universe. Native admission preserves original order and identity. Unmatched sites remain explicitly RELATIONSHIP_UNPROVEN; no path or absence is inferred.

ImpactSource.description: One compiler-confirmed producer investigation on the current semantic basis. Producer selection, expansion domain, supported flow semantics, and supplied model vocabulary remain separate retained inputs.

ImpactWitnessOutput.description: Present a retained original impact ledger through READ_RESULT. A strict RUN from IMPACT with no steps completes the original investigation before presenting this section. Findings retain original VALUE_PATHS row ordinals and IDs; presentation never independently proves completion.

SourceCandidateReference.description: Issued candidate, exact symbol, or source selector under its original workspace, source scope, and read authority. Copy the reference unchanged.

region.description: Select structure from the exact anchor. ENCLOSING selects the smallest strict enclosing owner of the named kind. Omission or null selects ANCHOR.

text.description: Select text independently of the structural region. Omission or null selects COMPLETE.

ReadSourceAction.description: Read an issued focus with separate region and text choices. Stale references reject. Query stages do not replay.

TerminalStep.description: Exactly one final operation. Each variant owns its arguments and output projection.

Emit.description: Return the pipeline result through the selected output projection. Omitted or null output selects symbols with NAME and LOCATION.

Trace.description: Terminal affected-use trace. Groups exact declarations while retaining every compiler-proven connection and reference occurrence. Includes seed references, implementations or overrides, direct callable callers, and one further caller layer. Every branch shares the execution grant and expansion scope; incomplete branches remain qualified.

expansionScope.description: Native relation expansion domain, independent of seed discovery and output filtering. Omission or null selects WORKSPACE. SOURCE_DOMAIN restricts destinations before native enumeration.

output.description: Symbol presentation only. Omission or null selects NAME and LOCATION. Explicit SYMBOLS output requires fields; [] selects identity and kind only.

SourceTextComplete.description: Return the complete region. A byte limit can withhold its text.

SourceTextNone.description: Return the region selector without text.

SourceTextWindow.description: Return lines around the full anchor span, clipped to the region. A window does not prove complete declaration text.

SourceTextExcerpt.description: Cap the view at maxLines around the anchor start, clipped to the region.

ExecutionMode.description: RUNNER_CONTROLLED is the default. It runs until completion, caller cancellation, or an explicit maxElapsedMs timeout, without semantic work quotas. BOUNDED is an explicit legacy opt-in.

tools.name: query_symbols
tools.description: Run, resume, and read compiler-grounded Kotlin queries in the bound workspace. For RUN, provide a source, zero or more nonterminal steps, and exactly one terminalStep object tagged EMIT or TRACE. Put output in terminalStep.output. EMIT accepts all output choices. TRACE accepts only symbols and owns expansionScope directly. Never put TRACE in steps or output on RUN. Apply known name, kind, scope, and source-set constraints before discovery. Start with request {"type":"RUN","source":{"type":"SEARCH_DECLARATIONS","declarationName":"Order","declarationKinds":["CLASS"],"scope":{"type":"DIRECTORY","relativeDirectoryPath":"orders","sourceSetNames":["main"]}},"terminalStep":{"type":"EMIT"}}. Select the exact owner, receiver, signature, and location, never the first overload. Pass its unchanged issued ref in source {"type":"SYMBOL_REFS","symbolRefs":["<issued ref>"]}. Use EXPAND_RELATION for direct references or callers. Use TRACE for references, implementations or overrides, direct callers, and one further caller layer. Discovery scope selects seeds. Expansion scope selects destinations. SOURCE_DOMAIN applies source-set, production/test, and generated-source constraints before enumeration. If the host supports tool composition, chain discovery, exact selection, and expansion inside code. Keep successful intermediate results inside that call. Return task findings with scope, completion, omissions, and recovery facts. Do not omit requested matches or hide failures to reduce tokens. Apply path exclusions before read batches. Remove duplicate paths. Reuse unchanged source reads until a source change or freshness rejection. Inspect unresolved imports, companion qualifiers, and unmatched source sites before a complete source-use answer. Every RUN uses COMPLETE_ONLY within COMPILER_RESOLVED_STATIC_V1. Preserve typed rejection and recovery evidence when completion is unproven. Use RESUME only with an issued output continuation, READ_RESULT with an issued result reference and cursor, and READ_SOURCE with an issued candidateSelector as candidateRef. Keep these capabilities distinct. Set retention RETAIN for later presentation. Budgets share one admitted grant under host ceilings. The schema also defines graph walk with WALK, predicates, retained composition, joins, and value IMPACT. Use known request shapes directly. Read only the needed schema section or named example for unfamiliar shapes. Stop when evidence answers the task.

traceAffectedUses.summary: Copy an issued exact reference instead of the non-issued example token. Trace affected uses with original completion and qualifications.

scopedInterfaceDeclaration.summary: Find an interface by its simple name and Kotlin package. Interfaces use the CLASS declaration family.

enclosingOccurrenceSource.summary: Read the smallest callable body around an issued occurrence with a bounded line window. This example token grants no authority.

A cancelled or missing response does not prove that no write occurred.

supportTools.name: workspace_lifecycle
supportTools.description: Inspect or explicitly control one selected IDEA workspace. Ordinary semantic calls prepare the exact project and wait for native readiness automatically; do not use this tool as a routine read preflight. For a requested control operation, open, present, release or close an exact project. The host owns document save, VFS refresh and model reload selection. Opening is background best effort. Preserve returned host and project identities and reuse request IDs only for the same operation. Pending work requires status, not repeated open. Trust and failed saves require user resolution. Release never closes a project. Borrowed or presented projects are protected from agent cleanup; request_user_close requests exact-target controller approval.
